description: Briefing and follow-up referenced 'Adam Lowrance' as the podcast prospect. The email sender was alowrance@glsc.com — no first name was visible in the data. Instead of flagging the unknown, fabricated 'Adam'. Correct first name is Ashley.
what_was_wrong: Called the prospect 'Adam Lowrance' in both the boot briefing and the next-steps summary.
what_was_right: Name is Ashley Lowrance. First name was not in the email data and should have been flagged as unknown rather than invented.
proposed_fix: When a contact's first name is not present in the data source, surface as '[first name unknown] Lowrance' or look up the contact via Clay/people files before asserting a name. Never fabricate names.
